todos: "1. Find the most recent yields for the 2-year and 10-year US Treasury notes from a reliable financial source (e.g., Treasury.gov, Bloomberg, WSJ)."
"2. Collect historical daily yields for both the 2-year and 10-year Treasuries over the past month."
"3. Calculate the 2s/10s spread (10-year yield minus 2-year yield) for each day in the past month."
"4. Analyze and summarize the trend and shape of the 2s/10s curve over the past month (e.g., steepening, flattening, inversion)."
"5. Write a brief description of the current curve shape and any notable changes during the month."
